column1: #   url       https git URL, or "alias:<tier>/<dir>" to point at another clone,
#             or "raw:<url>" to fetch a single file instead of cloning
#   sparse    comma-separated git sparse-checkout include patterns (root-anchored),
#             "-" to check out everything, "-" with url=raw:<...> to ignore
# Clones are shallow (--depth 1). Rows with a `sparse` pattern also use a
# blobless partial clone (--filter=blob:none) so we skip datasets, docs sites,
# test fixtures and logs we will never read. See fetch.sh.
